Catalogue.Name: Prop
Catalogue.Creator: EOSAT-1 SMDL Generator
Catalogue.Description: SMP2 model catalogue for Prop subsystem

Field.Name: prop_thrust_est
Field.Description: Thrust estimate at current feed pressure incl. degradation (330 BOL -> 140 EOL); physical thrust only while FIRING [mN]

Field.Name: prop_isp_est
Field.Description: Live specific impulse Isp(P) (220 BOL -> 196 EOL) [s]

Field.Name: prop_dv_remaining
Field.Description: Tsiolkovsky remaining delta-V on live propellant (CTG-028 usable envelope) [m/s]

Field.Name: prop_burn_dv_achieved
Field.Description: Achieved delta-V, last burn (post-burn OD cross-check) [m/s]

Field.Name: prop_burn_time_cmd
Field.Description: Predicted burn duration at current tank state [s]

Field.Name: prop_arm_inhibit_mask
Field.Description: Bitmask of interlocks blocking arm: b0 catbed, b1 tank P, b2 propellant, b3 AOCS mode, b4 att err, b5 SoC, b6 phase, b7 eclipse, b8 valves, b9 inhibit latched, b10 no burn loaded

Field.Name: prop_leak_rate
Field.Description: Propellant leak rate (0 nominal; the 0x0B01 delta monitor sees a leak first) [mg/s]

Field.Name: prop_thrust_offset_torque
Field.Description: Thrust-misalignment disturbance torque fed to AOCS (1650 uNm at BOL thrust) [uNm]

Field.Name: prop_sc_mass
Field.Description: Spacecraft mass m_dry + m_prop (12.40 BOL -> 12.00 dry) [kg]

Field.Name: prop_orbit_epoch_version
Field.Description: Orbit element-set version — increments per applied burn (planner/MCS cache key)

Field.Name: prop_sma_km
Field.Description: Semi-major axis from the active (post-burn) element set [km]

Field.Name: prop_power_draw
Field.Description: Live propulsion power draw (valves while armed/firing + catbed heater) — the EPS prop line bills this [W]

Field.Name: tc_PROP_SET_BURN_dv_m_s
Field.Description: Delta-V magnitude, m/s (0 < dv <= 20; checked against 0x0B0C remaining) | [m/s] | range [0.01, 20.0] | default 0.85

Field.Name: tc_PROP_SET_BURN_direction
Field.Description: 0=prograde (+X body, nominal nadir attitude), 1=retrograde (requires 180-deg yaw / INERTIAL hold) | default 0 | 0=PROGRADE | 1=RETROGRADE

Field.Name: tc_PROP_SET_BURN_mode
Field.Description: 0=open-loop timed, 1=closed-loop dv cut-off (accelerometer-integrated within this burn only) | default 1 | 0=OPEN_LOOP | 1=DV_CUTOFF

Field.Name: tc_PROP_SET_BURN_t_start_cuc
Field.Description: Burn start CUC (0 = fire on PROP_EXECUTE; normally S11 time-tagged per NOM-004) | [s(CUC)] | default 0

Field.Name: tc_PROP_ARM_arm_code
Field.Description: Fixed arm code 0xA5C3 (= 42435); any other value is rejected | default 42435

Field.Name: tc_PROP_SET_LIMITS_att_err_max_deg
Field.Description: Abort when 0x0217 exceeds this during a burn (default 2.0) | [deg] | range [0.1, 10.0] | default 2.0

Field.Name: tc_PROP_SET_LIMITS_p_min_bar
Field.Description: Abort below this feed pressure (default 4.0) | [bar] | range [1.0, 22.0] | default 4.0

Field.Name: tc_PROP_SET_LIMITS_catbed_max_c
Field.Description: Abort above this catbed temperature (default 350) | [degC] | range [200.0, 500.0] | default 350.0
